Author: Ravindra Maithani
Bench: Ravindra Maithani
 Office Notes,

 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order

S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures 10 WPMS No. 3507 of 2025  Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Mohit Kumar Kashyap, Advocate for the petitioners.
Mr. N.S. Pundir, D.A.G. for the State/respondents.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

It is argued that the controversy is squarely covered by the judgment dated 19.12.2025, passed by this Court in WPMS No. 3515 of 2025 Dhirajpal Singh Negi and others Vs. State of Uttarakhand and others.

entities.text: WPMS No. 3515 of 2025 Dhirajpal Singh Negi and others Vs. State of Uttarakhand and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This fact is admitted by learned counsel for the State/respondents.
The petition is decided in terms of judgment dated 19.12.2025 passed by this Court in the case of Dhirajpal Singh Negi (supra)

Accordingly, the petitioners are given liberty to approach appropriate authority under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency of Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency of Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
If the petitioners approach the authority,
the authority shall consider it expeditiously.

(Ravindra Maithani, J.) 29.12.2025 Jitendra WPMS/3507/2025 on 29 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31300173/
